questions.prompt: When did the chest pain start?
Can you describe what the chest pain feels like?
On a scale from 0 to 10, how severe is the chest pain right now?
Have you noticed any other symptoms with the chest pain, like shortness of breath, sweating, or nausea?
Have you noticed anything that triggers or relieves the chest pain?
Does the pain radiate to your arm, jaw, back, or anywhere else?
Is the pain related to exercise or physical activity?
Does the pain improve when you rest?
